About the Association

A Legacy Built on Brotherhood & Service

The Old Prunitians Association brings together former pupils and staff of Plumtree High School — one of Zimbabwe's most storied institutions. Nestled in Matabeleland South, Plumtree School has shaped leaders, scholars, and servants of society since its founding over a century ago.


Our association exists to preserve the Prunitian spirit, support the school's continued excellence, and keep the bonds of friendship alive across generations — whether you graduated last year or fifty years ago.


Mission

To unite, empower and celebrate every Prunitian through community, giving and lifelong fellowship.

Vision

A thriving global network that elevates the school's legacy and uplifts the Plumtree community.

Our Story

School History

1902
Founding of Plumtree School
Established by the London Missionary Society, Plumtree School opens its doors in Matabeleland South as one of Rhodesia's earliest mission schools, offering education to the local community.
Foundation
1920
Construction of the Main Block
The iconic main building — still standing today — is completed, featuring its distinctive red-tiled roof, white columns, and central courtyard garden, which would become the symbol of Prunitian identity.
Infrastructure
1948
First Full Cambridge Certificate Class
Plumtree School achieves its first full Cambridge School Certificate results, establishing a tradition of academic excellence that would define generations of Prunitians.
Academic
1963
Old Prunitians Association Founded
Former pupils formally establish the Old Prunitians Association, creating an enduring bond between alumni and their alma mater. The inaugural AGM is held in Bulawayo with 47 founding members.
Association
1980
Independence — A New Chapter
Zimbabwe gains independence and Plumtree School transitions fully into the new national education system. The school continues to thrive, now serving a broader and more diverse student body.
Milestone
1995
First Bursary Fund Established
Old Prunitians launch the first formal bursary fund, enabling talented students from disadvantaged backgrounds to access a Plumtree education. The inaugural fund supports 6 students.
Giving Back
2002
Centenary Celebrations
Plumtree School marks 100 years of excellence with a grand centenary celebration. Over 800 Old Prunitians from across the world return to the school for a historic reunion weekend.
Centenary
2025
Digital Alumni Network Launched
The Old Prunitians Association launches its digital platform, connecting thousands of alumni worldwide and bringing the Prunitian community together across generations and continents.
Today
